BrochureContent.Content:
KM PROPERTY is delighted to welcome you to Apartment 18 Doolin House, a spacious and beautifully presented first-floor two-bedroom apartment located in the highly regarded development of Clare Village. Spanning approximately 88 sq.m., this impressive apartment offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation throughout, complemented by a large private balcony and excellent storage. 

Viewing video: https://youtu.be/5pIJ44ywtJo

Internally, the property is approached via a spacious entrance hallway which provides access to all rooms. Immediately to the right is a convenient cloakroom, while a separate storage cupboard and generously sized hotpress provide excellent additional storage, a particularly valuable feature in apartment living. 

To the left of the hallway lies the impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and living area. The kitchen is fitted with a range of modern units and all mod cons, providing ample storage and workspace. The generous living and dining area is bright and inviting, with windows spanning the full width of the balcony allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the room. From here, a door leads directly out to the spacious balcony, creating an excellent extension of the living space and an ideal area for outdoor dining, relaxing or entertaining. The balcony also benefits from additional storage, providing a practical solution for bikes, outdoor furniture and other household items.

Returning to the hallway, the main bathroom is fully tiled and well appointed with a bath and overhead shower, wash hand basin and WC.

Bedroom one is a particularly generous double bedroom, featuring built-in wardrobes, an ensuite bathroom and a large window which allows plenty of natural light into the room. Bedroom two is also exceptionally well proportioned, with built-in wardrobes and ample space for a double bed and additional bedroom furniture.

The property is finished with porcelain tiled flooring throughout the main living accommodation, with the bedrooms offering a softer finish underfoot. The overall layout provides spacious, comfortable and versatile accommodation, making this an ideal home for first-time buyers, owner occupiers or those seeking a well-located investment property.

Doolin House enjoys an enviable position within Clare Village, with a host of amenities available close by. Clarehall Shopping Centre is just a short distance away and provides a variety of shops and services, including supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and other everyday conveniences. The surrounding area also offers a wide selection of schools, childcare facilities, recreational amenities and local services. The property is within easy reach of numerous parks, green spaces and coastal amenities, while the nearby areas of Malahide, Portmarnock, Clongriffin and Donaghmede offer an extensive choice of shopping, dining and leisure facilities. 

The property is also exceptionally well connected for commuters, with numerous Dublin Bus routes serving the surrounding area and providing convenient access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding suburbs. The DART is readily accessible from nearby stations, providing a direct rail connection towards Dublin City Centre, the Docklands and south Dublin. The M50 and M1 motorways are also within easy reach, while Dublin Airport is only a short drive away.

With its generous 88 sq.m. footprint, two large bedrooms, ensuite, excellent storage, bright open-plan living accommodation and substantial private balcony, Apartment 18 Doolin House offers a superb combination of space, comfort and convenience in a well-established residential setting.

For further details or to arrange a private viewing

, visit kmproperty.ie.
